findings.name: Vysota

findings.name: Варшавский
findings.evidence_quote: Gaming zone has been removed.
findings.note: Former Russian bemani location (ZIv comment: 'The best Russian bemani-location'). Gaming zone explicitly removed; last update 2020.

findings.name: Лига Пинбола
findings.evidence_quote: 19 локаций, 29 пинболов. Сейчас они работают в барах Санкт-Петербурга. ATC (Некрасова 3).
findings.note: SPb Pinball League places pinball machines in bars (including ATC Nekrasova 3-5). Pinball-only operation; not a rhythm arcade.

findings.name: Планета Игр
findings.evidence_quote: Цена кредита: 40 руб. 3 песни(ен) за кредит. Joint Premium: Да. No games at this location. Updated 2014-06-19.
findings.note: Legacy bemani pricing notes (3 songs/credit, Joint Premium) but empty game list and 2014 last update. Cannot confirm current open status or machines.

findings.name: Читай-Город (Chitai Gorod, not Arcade)
findings.evidence_quote: This store has a singular arcade. Samurai Shodown III: Blades of Blood. You can play this only after a book purchase.
findings.note: Bookstore (chitai-gorod.ru) with one fighter cab only. Name in shard already flags 'not Arcade'. No rhythm games.

findings.name: Adventure Island
findings.evidence_quote: FLAMINGO MALL - JEDDAH Kids play zone - Adventure Island: zip lines, donut slides, trampolines, wall climbing, ninja course, ball games.
findings.note: Jeddah Flamingo Park soft-play/adventure FEC. No public rhythm cab list found. ZIv empty.

findings.name: Iceland
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 3-DDX / D-Tech (International) Condition: Not Working. ice skating and karting and few f1 simulators and arcade games.
findings.note: ZIv lists 3DDX/D-Tech as music game but Not Working as of 2024. Other cabs are racers/shooters. 3DDX has no dedicated map slug so tagged other. Re-verify if machine restored.

findings.name: PlayOcity
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: ATV Slam; Asphalt 9 Legends Arcade DX; Jet Blaster; Super Bikes 3; Transformers Human Alliance; Transformers: Shadows Rising
findings.note: Village Mall Jeddah FEC. ZIv cab notes are racers/shooters only; no rhythm titles in inventory.

findings.name: Sparky's
findings.evidence_quote: Sparky's is a family entertainment center offering arcade games, rides, bowling, and interactive attractions.
findings.note: Chain FEC at Andalus Mall Jeddah. Arcade present but no public Bemani/SEGA rhythm cab list found.

findings.name: Claw-Pi-Tiam
findings.evidence_quote: A store that focuses entirely on claw machines. Most (if not all) machines take 2 tokens per play. No games at this location.
findings.note: Plaza Singapura claw-only store. Instagram/YouTube confirm plush/collectible claws only.

findings.name: Fun Claw (Plaza Singapura)
findings.evidence_quote: A fun space exclusively for claw machines. Fun Claw is a new concept of automated toy catcher. Plaza Singapura #04-68A
findings.note: CapitaLand listing: exclusively claw machines. funclawsingapore.com describes claw retail entertainment only.

findings.name: TOG - Toy Or Game (Plaza Singapura)
findings.evidence_quote: A store that primarily sells video games, consoles, anime figures, plushies, and manga. There are some arcades games in the front. Animal Kaiser PLUS Comment: 2 cabs.
findings.note: Retail shop with Animal Kaiser card-battle cabs only. No rhythm games.

findings.name: The Centrepoint
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Animal Kaiser. Address: 176 Orchard Rd Singapore 238843.
findings.note: Entry is the mall itself, not a named arcade. Animal Kaiser only on ZIv. Do not attach iClaw (z10333) lineup. Ambiguous mall-level stub.

findings.name: Tokyo Games Station @ KINEX
findings.evidence_quote: Street Fighter III 3rd Strike; Ultra Street Fighter IV (6 machines); KOF 98; KOF 2003; X-Men vs. Street Fighter; Pandora's Box DX; Puzzle Bobble; Shoot Away Pro; THE BishiBashi.
findings.note: KINEX fighting-game room. Full ZIv list is fighters/puzzle/BishiBashi; no DDR/maimai/PIU etc. Still referenced as open for retro fighters.

findings.name: Whimsy (Downtown East)
findings.evidence_quote: We focus on Redemption game. Car racing, music, gun shooting, fishing game, etc.
findings.note: ZIv cabs: Ghost Squad, Street Basketball, BishiBashi, Wangan Midnight 6RR. Site says generic 'music' without naming Bemani/SEGA rhythm. No confirmed valid-slug rhythm cab.

findings.name: Zone X @ Changi Airport T3
findings.evidence_quote: Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 6RR Comment: 4 cabinets. Let's Go Island (Deluxe Cab).
findings.note: Airport Zone X (still listed on zonex.com.sg). ZIv 2025 inventory is racing/shooter only; no rhythm.

findings.name: iClaw Taiwan (The Centrepoint)
findings.evidence_quote: There are a few videogames amongst the claw machines. THE BishiBashi; Pac-Man Battle Royale; Daytona USA (2P); Gunbullet X.
findings.note: Primarily claw shop with a few non-rhythm video cabs. No music games.

findings.name: Fantasia @ Matlosana Mall
findings.evidence_quote: In this arcade, there's a cabinet that has a Dancing Stage banner in which it is running a Stepmania 3.9 software. Music Game: Dancing Stage (Europe) Comment: It's running a Stepmania 3.9 software. Updated 2026-07-06.
findings.note: Dancing Stage-branded pad running StepMania 3.9 (not official Konami e-amusement). Mapped to ddr as European DDR brand lineage. Gameplay short cited on ZIv (YouTube/TikTok).

findings.name: Nitro Park & NitroVR @ Baywest Mall
findings.evidence_quote: No music game listing; venue name Nitro Park & NitroVR @ Baywest Mall.
findings.note: VR/go-kart style venue name. No public rhythm cab evidence found.

findings.name: Ten Flags Theme Park
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Dance Central 3.
findings.note: ZIv notes Dance Central 3 (Kinect home-console dance title), not a dedicated Bemani/Andamiro cab. No valid dedicated slug; tagged other. Theme park still operating (Facebook/tenflagsthemepark).

findings.name: Virtual Reality Zone @ uShaka Marine World
findings.evidence_quote: They have access to a huge Beat Saber VR setup. Music Game: Beat Saber Arcade (North America).
findings.note: Beat Saber VR is rhythm but not in dedicated slug list; tagged other. Evidence from 2021; re-verify current uShaka lineup.

findings.name: Doremi Joyworld
findings.evidence_quote: 객사 도레미 죠이월드 listed under 오락실/전북/폐업 (Jeonbuk closed arcades).
findings.note: Jeonju Gaeksa Doremi Joyworld on namu closed list. Older blogs mention jubeat there before closure. Address matches shard (Jeonjugaeksa area).

findings.name: Dragon Hill Spa & Resort
findings.evidence_quote: Address 40 Hangang-daero 21na-gil Yongsan-gu Seoul but stored lat/lng ~36.72,128.22 (not Seoul Yongsan).
findings.note: Jjimjilbang/spa complex; no rhythm cab evidence. Coordinates in shard appear wrong vs stated Yongsan address. Ambiguous; leave unknown.

findings.name: Game GwangJang(게임광장)
findings.evidence_quote: 익산 게임광장이 20년 5월 19일 부로 문을 닫습니다. 리듬게임 인생 7년을 함께한 오락실인데.
findings.note: Iksan Game Gwangjang closed 2020-05-19 per contemporaneous tweet. Also on namu 오락실/전북/폐업.

findings.name: Joyplaza
findings.evidence_quote: Address 전라북도 익산시 신동 800-4. No games listed on ZIv.
findings.note: Iksan Shindong Joyplaza. Nearby Game Gwangjang closed 2020; this venue's current status and lineup not independently verified. Do not attach other Joyplaza (e.g. Jinju) lineups.

findings.name: O'rack Cafe
findings.evidence_quote: THE BishiBashi; Street Fighter II; Tekken 6 x2; Tekken Tag; Bubble Bobble; Puzzle Bobble; TETRIS; Let's Go Jungle; Metal Slug 3; Galaga; Basketball; Speed Hockey. Updated 2017-08-27.
findings.note: 2017 ZIv inventory is classic/fighter only, no rhythm. Stale; open status unverified. If still open, prior list had no map-slug music games.

findings.name: RackHyu(樂休) Game Center
findings.evidence_quote: 락휴테마파크 광주 광산구 월계로 173-5. PUMP PHOENIX 2 units. Taiko NIJIIRO 1 unit. Also EZ2AC FINAL EX, EZ2AC TIME TRAVELER, BeatOn XX.
findings.note: Gwangsan RackHyu Theme Park / Game Land. Musecat lists PIU Phoenix x2 and Taiko Nijiiro x1 (photos 2024-08). EZ2AC/BeatOn not in valid slug list (omit or other). Address matches shard. Also on namu pump/taiko distribution pages.

findings.name: Star Game Center (Star 청소년 오락실)
findings.evidence_quote: 두정동 스타 청소년 오락실 [편집] listed under 오락실/충남/폐업.
findings.note: Cheonan Dujeong-dong Star Youth Arcade on namu Chungnam closed list. ZIv address matches Dujeong-dong 700.

findings.name: 우리들의 놀이터 (Our Playground)
findings.evidence_quote: 방학동에서 '우리들의 놀이터' 상호로 운영하던 시절... 2014년 5월에 경기도 의정부시로 이전을 했다. 도봉구 에는 오락실 이 하나도 없다.
findings.note: Dobong Banghak-dong location closed/relocated May 2014 to Uijeongbu as 아케이드원 (Arcade One). Seoul open-data lists 우리들의 놀이터 도봉로 675 as 폐업. Do not attach current Arcade One games to this sid.

findings.name: ACAPA Alcàsser
findings.evidence_quote: Asociación Cultural de Arcade y Pinball de Alcàsser. An association with pinball machines and classic arcade games. Street Fighter II; Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga; MAME; Megatouch; Pandora's Box DX; Dr Who; Foo Fighters; Jack-Bot; Super Hoop; X-Men Pro; TETRIS.
findings.note: Cultural association: pinball + retro arcade. Full ZIv/pinballmap inventory has no Bemani/SEGA rhythm.

findings.name: Akiba Games
findings.evidence_quote: maimai FiNALE (Japan) Comment: Offline, all unlocked including RE:MAS, UTAGE, dans and PANDORA BOXXX songs. 1€ / 3 SONGS. Feel free to ask the owner to raise the volume on the Maimai cabinet. Updated 2026-06-28.
findings.note: Castellon retro game store with playable JP maimai FiNALE (offline). Mapped to maimai_dx as only maimai series slug; hardware is FiNALE not DX. Photo of cabinet on ZIv.

findings.name: Apartamentos Terralta
findings.evidence_quote: Hotel with arcade. Pinball; GRID Twin; Motocross Go; OutRun 2 (bootleg Xbox); Operation G.H.O.S.T.; Claw Machine.
findings.note: Benidorm hotel basement arcade. 2019 inventory racers/claw/pinball only. Stale; no rhythm then.

findings.name: Arcade Events Nasas Nigrán
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Daytona USA 2: Power Edition (2P); The Fast and the Furious (2P); The House of the Dead 4.
findings.note: Nigran event venue (nasasnigran.com). ZIv notes racing/shooter only.

findings.name: Arena Dorada
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Ace Driver; Cruis'n Blast; Deadstorm Pirates; Fast & Furious Arcade (2022); Halo Fireteam Raven; Jurassic Park Arcade; Super Bikes 3; House of the Dead Scarlet Dawn; The Walking Dead.
findings.note: Lanzarote (Tias) FEC. ZIv cab list racers/shooters only; no rhythm.

findings.name: Aroma Souvenirs
findings.evidence_quote: Aroma is a souvenir shop in Duquesa, Spain. Falgas Tutti Frutti Carousel; Falgas Pirate Boat; Falgas Max Truck; Cogan Batmobile; Falgas Magnum Car.
findings.note: Souvenir/press shop with outdoor kiddie rides only. Not a rhythm arcade.

findings.name: Bolera Birles Alzira
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Beast Busters Second Nightmare; Road's Edge; TECMO WORLD CUP '98; TETRIS; Terminator 2; X-Men vs. Street Fighter; Zero Point.
findings.note: Bowling alley with old fighters/shooters. No rhythm on ZIv notes. Inventory age unknown.

findings.name: Bolera Strike
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade and bowling, located in Bonaire, first floor. Ex-place of a Pump it Up Exceed. Current games: Fast & Furious Arcade (2022); HOUSE OF THE DEAD: SCARLET DAWN. Updated 2026-05-21.
findings.note: PIU Exceed was formerly here (historical photos on ZIv) but removed. Current 2026 list is racer + shooter only. Site is bowling/kids/arcade FEC.

findings.name: Bowling Bahia
findings.evidence_quote: A bowling and a arcade place... games from Sega, Naomi, Namco, Rawthrills/Midway. Extensive list: Mario Kart GP2/DX, Daytona, OutRun 2, Time Crisis 4/II, Cruis'n Blast, Virtua Fighter 4, redemption, etc. No music games section.
findings.note: Large Los Barrios bowling arcade. Very long ZIv inventory of racers/shooters/redemption; no DDR/PIU/maimai/etc.

findings.name: Bowling Chamartín
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade inside the bowling alley. No games at this location. Comment: nvm rip initial D they sold it to somewhere in coruña.
findings.note: Madrid Chamartin station bowling. Had Initial D (sold). No rhythm evidence; remaining lineup unclear after Initial D sale.
